keyFindings: Certified composite property tax rate is 2.76%, with an equalization ratio of 83.6%.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Mountain Lakes Borough, homeowners pay an average of $24,227.28 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 9.69% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 83.6%, assessed values average ~83.6% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 68.8% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 21.4%, and Morris County claims 9.8%.
